name: Inaka no Gakko de Natsuyasumi ♀♀♀×♂
original_name: 田舎のがっこで夏休み♀♀♀×♂
source:
After 30 job rejections the protagonist was depressed.
He found it harder and harder to get up in the morning.
His uncle gave him a call.

"Give yourself a break and come out here for the summer.
You could do some part-time work, yeah?"

It wasn't a bad proposal. He could be a general helping hand.
His uncle's house was out in the countryside.

Here he met three schoolgirls, and became friends with each of them in the following days.

It was a summer of awakening for them all.
